text:
You need a motivated, phone-savvy lead generation specialist who can pre-qualify warm homeowners leads, overcome objections, and work on commission-based performance.  

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, SQL, data cleaning, and dashboard work, and I’m comfortable working with structured lead lists and keeping data organized and accurate. While my background is analytical, I’m strong in handling process-driven work and translating information into clear next steps.  

In my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model, consolidating 14 separate Excel sales reports and cutting monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. In my Inventory reconciliation automation project for Coastline Hardware, I built a Power Query workbook that matched warehouse counts to the ERP and flagged variances, finding $86k of stock variance and reducing weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.  

I’d love to bring that same focus and discipline to your lead flow.
